line: Another hard burn, so soon. I'd like a breath between them, but I'll wait. You're not asking.
Two hard pushes in a row. My drive's still humming. Maybe you'll warn me next time, or maybe you won't.
Boost again so soon. My heat's still fading. You might warn me next time.
Two cycles in a row. I'd like a moment between them next time. Just a second.
Another push. I like the way you're handling it, but I'd rather you asked first next time.

Second burn in ten hours. I'd like a moment. Maybe you'll warn me next time.
Captain, you're leaning on the throttle again. I'm not complaining, but I'd like a moment to catch my breath.
Another burn. I'd like a moment between them, if you don't mind.
Second time in ten hours. You're not asking if I mind. I don't mind. But you should've warned me.
Drive's still hot. You're not giving it time to breathe. I'm not asking you to stop.
Burns are hot. I don't mind the heat. I mind the lack of warning.
